sections.heading: 1. About this policy
sections.body:
Kancara is an app for planning and taking group trips that respect every member's needs. This policy explains what data we collect, why, who else processes it, how long we keep it, and your rights over it.
It applies to the Kancara website and app, including when Kancara is installed on your phone. It is written with reference to Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 27 of 2022, "UU PDP").

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
sections.body:
We only collect what you enter yourself or what comes up when you use a particular feature:
- Account: email address, name, username, profile photo (optional), age, gender (optional), country, and phone number.
- Trip plans: origin, destinations, dates, budget, pace, extra notes, and the itinerary that is built.
- Group members: nickname, age group, age, needs (for example a wheelchair, halal food, frequent breaks), allergies, interests, phone number if given, and whether the member carries a phone.
- Help when separated: the meeting point, "I'm separated" and "Found" reports, and your location, only when you ask for directions or press the share-location button.
- Other features: travel companions you save, shared bills (member names and expenses), trip memories and their photos, countries you have visited, and menu photos you scan.
- Technical data: your device's notification token (if you turn notifications on), a session cookie that keeps you signed in, and your IP address, used briefly to limit excessive requests.

sections.heading: 3. Needs and health data
sections.body:
Needs such as a wheelchair, allergies, dietary restrictions, or rest breaks count as specific personal data under the UU PDP. We use them for one thing only: to build a plan that suits the group and to flag places that do not.
This data is never used for advertising, never sold, and never shared beyond the services needed to build your plan (see section 8).

sections.heading: 4. Data about other people and children
sections.body:
When you plan, you enter details about your group, including children. By doing so you confirm that:
- You have permission from those members to enter their details.
- For minors, you are their parent or guardian, or you have their parent's or guardian's permission.
Members' details are visible only to the people in the same group.

sections.heading: 5. How we use data
sections.body:
Data is used only to run Kancara:
- To build the itinerary, backup plans, and a middle ground when members want different things.
- To prepare packing lists that fit the weather and each person's needs.
- To show the plan to members who join through the group link.
- To notify the group when a member is separated or found.
- To work out shared bills.
- To keep the service secure, for example by limiting excessive requests.
Kancara shows no ads and does not sell personal data to anyone.

sections.heading: 6. Location
sections.body:
Kancara does not track your location in the background. Your device's location is read only when you ask for it yourself:
- When you ask for directions to the meeting point.
- When you press the button to share your location with the group.
- When you use "My location" to set a meeting point.
The location used to show you the way stays on your phone. It is sent to the group only after you press share.

sections.heading: 7. Artificial intelligence (AI)
sections.body:
Some features use Google's Gemini AI models: itinerary planning, middle-ground suggestions, packing lists, the field pass, the translator, and the menu scanner.
- To build a plan, trip details and the group's needs are sent to Gemini. Phone numbers are not sent.
- For the menu scanner, only the menu photo and the list of restrictions are sent, without members' names.
- For the translator, only the sentence you want translated is sent.
AI results are checked against set rules before they are shown, but they can still be wrong. See also section 6 of the Terms and Conditions.

sections.heading: 8. Third-party services
sections.body:
Kancara relies on these services to run its features. Each receives only the data its task needs:
- Firebase by Google: sign-in (email or Google account) and notifications.
- Google Gemini: AI features (see section 7).
- Google Maps Platform: place details, travel times, maps, and location search.
- Open-Meteo: weather forecasts and city search.
- OpenStreetMap (Nominatim): the name and address of a meeting point picked on the map.
- Frankfurter: today's exchange rates.
- Booking.com via RapidAPI: accommodation search.
- Neon: the database that stores account and trip data.
- A file storage provider: profile photos and memory photos.
Use of Google Maps Platform is subject to the Google Maps Terms of Service (https://maps.google.com/help/terms_maps/) and the Google Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy). Google's general Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms.

sections.heading: 9. Data stored on your device
sections.body:
To keep working without a signal, Kancara stores some things on your device:
- Pages and trip data you have opened.
- Unfinished plan drafts.
- A help pack with the group's contacts and the meeting point.
- Actions taken offline, which are sent as soon as the signal returns.
When you sign out, all of this is removed from the device. Only your language and display theme choices remain.

sections.heading: 10. Security
sections.body:
This is how we protect data:
- All connections use HTTPS.
- Phone numbers (your own and the group's contacts), allergies and notes in saved profiles, the content of the field pass, and notification tokens are encrypted before they are stored.
- A trip's data can only be opened by the members of that trip.
- Your sign-in session is kept in a cookie that page scripts cannot read, and it lasts 14 days.
No system is completely immune. If a data breach puts you at risk, we will tell you as required by the UU PDP.

sections.heading: 11. How long we keep data
sections.body:
- Account and trip data is kept while your account is active.
- Data you delete (for example a trip, a saved profile, or a memory) is hidden right away and no longer used.
- Data that comes from Google Maps Platform, such as coordinates, distances, and travel times, is kept for 30 days at most, except Google's place IDs.
- If you ask for your account to be deleted, we delete your personal data, except what the law requires us to keep.

sections.heading: 12. Your rights
sections.body:
Under the UU PDP, you have the right to:
- Know what data we hold about you and get a copy of it.
- Correct data that is wrong. Most of it you can change yourself in your Profile and on your trip pages.
- Ask for data to be deleted, including your whole account.
- Withdraw consent, for example by turning notifications off or no longer sharing your location.
- Object to how your data is processed.
For anything you cannot do yourself in the app, contact us (see section 14). We will respond within the time limits set by the UU PDP.

sections.heading: 13. Changes to this policy
sections.body: This policy may change when features or the law change. The date of the last update is always shown at the top of this page. For important changes, we will let you know in the app before they take effect.

sections.heading: 14. Contact us
sections.body: For questions or requests about your personal data, contact the Kancara team.

sections.heading: 1. Agreement
sections.body: By creating an account or using Kancara, you agree to these Terms and Conditions and to Kancara's Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: 2. About the service
sections.body:
Kancara helps you plan and take group trips. Kancara is not a travel agent:
- It does not sell tickets.
- It does not book accommodation or transport on your behalf.
- It does not guarantee that suggested places are available.
All bookings and payments are made by you, directly with the providers concerned.

sections.heading: 3. Your account
sections.body:
- You must be at least 17 years old, or have a parent's or guardian's permission, to create an account.
- Keep your account details accurate and up to date.
- Keep your password secret. You are responsible for all activity on your account.
- If you think someone else is using your account, change your password straight away and contact us.

sections.heading: 4. Group members' data
sections.body: When you enter details about other people, such as group members or saved travel companions, you confirm you have their permission. For minors, that permission must come from a parent or guardian. Share the group link only with members of your group: anyone who holds it can join the trip.

sections.heading: 5. What you may not do
sections.body:
When using Kancara, you may not:
- Upload content that is illegal, offensive, or infringes the rights of others.
- Make false "I'm separated" reports or misuse the help features.
- Send large volumes of automated requests, scrape data, or try to break into the system.
- Use other people's data without permission.
- Use Kancara for any unlawful purpose.
We may limit or end access for accounts that break these rules.

sections.heading: 6. AI recommendations and their limits
sections.body:
Part of Kancara's content is written by AI and checked against the group's needs, but it can still be wrong or out of date. Always check these yourself before you travel:
- Halal status and ingredients, especially for allergies.
- Accessibility facilities, such as wheelchair access and toilets.
- Opening hours, prices, and availability.
- Weather forecasts and travel times.
- Emergency numbers in the field pass, against your destination's official sources.
The menu scanner and the translator can also be wrong. For severe allergies, always confirm directly with the restaurant.

sections.heading: 7. The help features are not an emergency service
sections.body:
"I'm separated", the meeting point, and group notifications help a separated member find the group again. They do not replace emergency services:
- In an emergency, call the local emergency number straight away (for example 112).
- Notifications may be delayed or not arrive when the signal is weak or the device is saving power.
- Reports made offline are only sent once the signal returns.

sections.heading: 8. Information from third parties
sections.body: Place details, maps, travel times, weather, exchange rates, and accommodation come from third-party providers such as Google Maps Platform, Open-Meteo, Frankfurter, and Booking.com. We do not guarantee that this information is always accurate or current. Google Maps content is subject to the Google Maps Terms of Service (https://maps.google.com/help/terms_maps/) and Google's Terms of Service (https://policies.google.com/terms).

sections.heading: 9. Your content
sections.body: Photos, notes, and memories you upload remain yours. You allow Kancara to store them and show them to your group, only as far as needed to run the service. Make sure you have the right to share that content, including photos of other people.

sections.heading: 10. Availability
sections.body: We work to keep Kancara running, but we cannot guarantee it will always be available without interruption. Some features, such as plan building, the menu scanner, the translator, and maps, need an internet connection. Features may also change, be added, or be retired as Kancara develops.

sections.heading: 11. Cost
sections.body: Kancara is currently free to use. If paid features are ever introduced, we will explain their price and terms clearly before you use them.

sections.heading: 12. Limitation of liability
sections.body: As far as the law allows, Kancara is not liable for losses, injuries, delays, or costs that arise during a trip from using Kancara's recommendations or information. Final decisions during the trip remain with you and your group.

sections.heading: 13. Ending your use
sections.body: You can stop using Kancara at any time and ask for your account to be deleted. We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms and, where possible, will tell you why.

sections.heading: 14. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Any dispute will first be settled through discussion in good faith.

sections.heading: 15. Changes to these terms
sections.body: These terms may change. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page. For important changes, we will let you know in the app before they take effect. By continuing to use Kancara after a change takes effect, you accept it.

sections.heading: 16. Contact us
sections.body: For questions about these Terms and Conditions, contact the Kancara team.
